sources.citation: docs/samlex-evo-1212f-1224f-manual-fw0.79.pdf — Fig 2.1 legend items 6, 7, 8 (NEWLY ADDED to docs/ this pass)

blocks: There is no data bus to talk to. The owner's manual (fw 0.79) Fig 2.1 legend item 8 reads, in full: 'RJ-45 Jack (marked "COMM") - for future use.' The words 'Modbus', 'RS-485', 'COMM 1', 'COMM 2' and 'CANbus' do not appear anywhere in that manual. The only other RJ-45s are item 6 (battery temp sensor / lithium BMS dry contact) and item 7 (EVO-RC-PLUS remote).
sharedMapEvidence: One vendor manual covers all four models (docs/samlex-evo-1212f-1224f-manual-fw0.79.pdf, cover page lists EVO-1212F / 1212F-HW / 1224F / 1224F-HW), and the EVO-RC-PLUS manual §5.2.2.1 Fig 5.1 gives them one shared data-logging field list. Both documents name all four together.
gotchas: These are the models a Quebec retailer sells as 'EVO 1200 W with remote panel referenced', and the remote reference is true — but it is the EVO-RC-PLUS on the dedicated Remote Control jack, not a data port. Do not let 'EVO series' plus 'Modbus' from the 2200 W manual leak onto these. The vendor put a jack labelled COMM
Firmware rev 0.79 as documented. If Samlex ships a later firmware that activates the COMM jack, this entry is stale — the claim is scoped to that revision.
Reachable via the samlex-evo-signal-io dialect instead: these models do have the Status Relay, the Remote On/Off input, and the 12 V signalling source (manual §6.7).
unmappedReports: Nothing is reported over a wire, but for the record the RC-PLUS SD-card log for these models carries: Output Volt/current/watt/freq, Grid volt, Input current/VA/watt, Battery volt/current, External current, Battery temperature, Transformer temperature, Heat sink temperature 1 and 2, Fan speed, Mode, Error code, Charge stage, Event. Same contract gaps as the other EVO dialects (AC input side, internal thermals, mode, error code, fan speed) — they just are not reachable.
